page_title: MAI 2-2 FRE | Mainz v Freiburg 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
87' The foul by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benjamin Brand.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vincenzo Grifo as he is replaced by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg).
83' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Benjamin Brand interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' 2 - 2 Goal! Ritsu Doan puts the ball across the area and Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:2.
77' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Here is a change. Kiliann Sildillia is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch for Maximilian Eggestein.
74' 2 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Anthony Caci is pounced on by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz). His close-range strike flashes past Noah Atubolu and into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
73' Surely that's handball by one of the Freiburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Anthony Caci (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Anthony Caci (Mainz) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
68' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Robin Zentner easily deals with the threat.
67' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
65' Freiburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

64' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Robin Zentner dived superbly to block a header by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Robin Zentner pulled off a remarkable save!
63' 4:16 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

62' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Robin Zentner guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
58' 1 - 1 Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
56' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
56' Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Freiburg take a short corner kick.

54' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Robin Zentner, who pulls off a stunning save!
53' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
48' Paul Nebel (Mainz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benjamin Brand saw the whole situation.
46' Half-time substitution. Phillipp Mwene is replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Julian Schuster gives a chance to Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) and Junior Adamu is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from the by-line finds Junior Adamu (Freiburg) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
45' The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
45' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Robin Zentner has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
44' Freiburg win a free kick.
43' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Dominik Kohr (Mainz) has to leave the pitch!
43' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Freiburg! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Benjamin Brand and both teams have no complaints.
43' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Freiburg using VAR. Let's see what happens.
41' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) has received a yellow card for his foul.
41' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Freiburg!
37' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benjamin Brand no option but to blow his whistle.
34' 1 - 0 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
33' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
32' The referee blows his whistle as Anthony Caci (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
28' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
28' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Phillipp Mwene (Mainz), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
25' Paul Nebel (Mainz) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
23' That's a well-taken pass by Anthony Caci (Mainz). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
22' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
18' Dangerous play by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg). Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
17' 0:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
14' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
12' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Noah Atubolu intercepts the ball.
7' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
6' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
4' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
2' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
